images.caption: Figure 3:Components of an FDE-Gym task, showing the inputs, agent actions and deliverable, deployment and evaluation of the delivered system, and interpretation of the resulting score. The agent reads the task inputs and exchanges messages with customer stakeholders, who answer questions and may also initiate contact. A task is included only if the scoring anchors shown on the axis are satisfied.
Figure 4:A worked example: the drilling scenario (oil_npt), original task.

Figure 5:(a)Share of key stakeholder facts obtained against normalized business uplift, at L3. Leading models learn most of the facts and deliver 0.60–0.70 of the reference uplift.(b)Mean model usage cost per run against score at L3.
Figure 6:Distribution of each model’s 95 tasks at L3 by score band. Scores of 0.2 or below correspond to the cap on literal compliance with the sponsor’s task instruction.

Figure 7:Mean score at L3 on each scenario, for each model; scenarios are ordered by the best model’s score, and the highest-scoring cell in each row is outlined. Color runs from red (below the do-nothing baseline) to blue (at the reference solution).
Figure 8:Model performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1, Vibe Code Bench, Finance Agent, and FDE-Gym.
